title: Seven Segment Searches
description: Decode scrambled seven-segment displays by deducing wire-to-segment mappings.
writeup:
## Approach

Each display has a random permutation of the 7 wire-to-segment connections. Find the correct permutation by testing all 7! = 5040 possibilities against the known digit patterns.

## Part 1

Digits 1, 4, 7, and 8 use a unique number of segments (2, 4, 3, and 7 respectively). Simply count output values with these lengths.

## Part 2

For each display, try all 5040 permutations of wire assignments. A permutation is valid if every signal pattern, when translated through the mapping, produces a known digit. Once the valid mapping is found, translate the four output values and combine them into a 4-digit number. Sum all decoded outputs.

While brute-force, 5040 permutations per display is fast enough. A deductive approach using set intersections is also possible but less clear.
